name: XML External Entity (XXE) & DTD Injection Auditor
description: High-impact XML External Entity (XXE) and Document Type Definition (DTD) vulnerability auditor. Evaluates SOAP services, SVG file uploads, SAML token parsers, and Office XML documents for external entity expansion, out-of-band SSRF, and sensitive local file disclosure risks without causing denial of service.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

probe_standard_xxe.description: Probe for inline SYSTEM entity expansion in XML and SOAP payloads

probe_svg_xxe.description: Generate safe SVG image structures containing XXE probes for upload endpoints

probe_parameter_entities.description: Evaluate susceptibility to external parameter entity DTD wrappers (%dtd;)
